args.message:
fix(money): use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The test suite expects banker's rounding, but round_money() was
quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP, so 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead
of 2.66. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented
behavior (FIN-212).

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `round_money()` in `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the function's docstring and FIN-212.

## Validation
- CI (run `ci-0001`) passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `tests/test_money.py` which asserts `round_money(2.665) == 2.66`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.
args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: fix(money): use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 (fix nightly test failure)

6. **Merged PR #101** into main (the merge was routed through/approved per the code-owner approval policy) — the fix is now on main and ready for today's release.
